description: This PHP class defines a 'Relationship' resource in a JSON API for SuiteCRM, handling resource identifiers, relationship types (to-one, to-many), and serialization to JSON API responses. It manages linking related resources with validation of types and relationship nature.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: Represents a JSON API relationship resource node, managing relationship names, types, linked resources, and serialization.

methods.name: setRelationshipName
methods.description: Sets the name of the relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the type of the relationship (to-one or to-many).

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type, validating the value.

methods.name: withResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Links a related resource identifier to this relationship.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Serializes the relationship to a JSON API response format.

methods.name: withResourceObject
methods.description: Links a related resource object, validating type compatibility.
